                         Based on June Perry Purple/Pink, but with some of the calcium swapped for zinc.


                        The zinc causes the mottling as it counteracts the chrome tin effect. If you're not getting
                          any colour variation then try swapping more calcium for zinc, if you're not getting any
                             colour at all try swapping some of the zinc back to calcium.

                                    Original Language: English

                                 Revisions Raspberry Ripple, rev. Ulexite, Zircopax, zinc, Raspberry Riff (1.5 Zinc), Raspberry Ripple

                                                                                                                                I got very little colour from a version of this recipe I made up
                                                                          to swap Frit 3134 for Gerstley Borate

                                                                              test batch SG was 1.48.


                                                            Based on Marc’s comment above, I assume that the issue is

                                                                     the top temperature. I may try reducing the zinc to see if I can
                                                                    get more pink/red.
